_comment: The single catalog of EXTERNAL things: free software you install (kind "software") and real-world help services/websites (kind "service"). Rendered identically by the native Tools page (src/gui/pages/tools.rs) and the web Tools page (web/pages/tools.html). Add entries here, never in code (Infinite-of-X). Replaced data/tools/catalog.json, data/resources/catalog.json and data/resources.json on 2026-07-30.
